mapper.sql: s.service_id,s.service_name,s.service_intro,s.category_id,c.category_name,s.carousel_images,s.detail_image,s.product_image,s.price,s.master_price,s.commission_type,s.commission_rate,s.city_id,ct.city_name,s.original_price,s.unit_id,u.unit_name,u.measure_type,s.sort_num,s.status,s.detail_content,COALESCE(s.extra_time_only,0) extra_time_only,(select count(*) from zjudg_order o where o.service_id=s.service_id) reserve_count,s.create_by,s.create_time,s.update_by,s.update_time,s.remark
mapper.select:
select from zjudg_service s left join zjudg_service_category c on c.category_id=s.category_id left join zjudg_service_unit u on u.unit_id=s.unit_id left join zjudg_city ct on ct.city_id=s.city_id
and (s.city_id is null or s.city_id='' or s.city_id=#{cityId})
order by s.sort_num asc,s.create_time desc

select from zjudg_service s left join zjudg_service_category c on c.category_id=s.category_id left join zjudg_service_unit u on u.unit_id=s.unit_id left join zjudg_city ct on ct.city_id=s.city_id where s.service_id=#{id}

select from zjudg_service s left join zjudg_service_category c on c.category_id=s.category_id left join zjudg_service_unit u on u.unit_id=s.unit_id left join zjudg_city ct on ct.city_id=s.city_id where s.status='0' and COALESCE(s.extra_time_only,0)=1 and u.measure_type='HOUR' and (s.city_id=#{cityId} or s.city_id is null or s.city_id='') order by case when s.city_id=#{cityId} then 0 else 1 end,s.sort_num,s.create_time desc limit 1

select count(*) from zjudg_service s left join zjudg_service_unit u on u.unit_id=s.unit_id where COALESCE(s.extra_time_only,0)=1 and u.measure_type='HOUR' and ((#{cityId} is null and (s.city_id is null or s.city_id='')) or s.city_id=#{cityId}) and (#{excludeServiceId} is null or s.service_id<>#{excludeServiceId})
mapper.delete: delete from zjudg_service where service_id in #{id}
